2. Ask the caller where they are and what happened
3. Put the incident in and send units
4. Watch them drive there on the map. If they need backup they radio you

Pre-Alpha v6.8.4.1: Balance Changes

Conquest: Napoleonic Wars is a real time strategy (RTS) game based on the Napoleonic era, inspired by Napoleon Total War and a successor to Conquest by captainwoodlegs. 

Keybinds
R = Rotate units
Z = Show units range
H = toggle march at same speed
X = ping
C = halt selected units
Q = select all the units
E = deselect all selected units
Left control = see all the units goals positions without having them selected
Left control and click on an unit = select units without deselect.
T + click = move units into a line automatically
Shift + click = move all the selected units in formation rather than all to the same place
Shift + click a unit = selecting all the units of the same type
Shift + press a number = select all units of the same type

MOBILE 
Double tap and hold = dragging to select multiple units at once

Use /private in your own private server to open or close the servers settings UI
Use /unstuck if ur character cant move

Games.Description:
LOW RANGE | EARLY ACCESS

A slow, technical offroad driving game. Each stage is one trail from start to finish, inspired by real offroad tracks around the world. Speed won't get you through. Reading the ground and setting up your truck will.

HOW IT PLAYS

- PICK YOUR LINE: mud, roots, rock and water all change how your truck grips and climbs.
- SET UP YOUR TRUCK: air down your tires, lock the diffs and drop into low range when the trail gets hard.
- WINCH OUT: stuck? Hook a tree or a friend's truck and pull yourself free.
- MANAGE YOUR FUEL: 4WD burns more. Fuel caches on the trail fill your tank and act as checkpoints.
- MUD THAT REMEMBERS: ruts get deeper with every truck that passes, for everyone on the server.

Drive solo or with friends, help each other through the hard parts, and come back to beat your best times.

Keyboard, mouse and controller supported.

Early access: things will change and some will break.
